family_ood.description: Held-out-family split: test families (halide, sulfide, nasicon, hydride, polymer_composite, borohydride, antiperovskite, garnet, perovskite, argyrodite) never appear in train. Tests oxide-trained generalization to unseen chemistries.

composition_ood.description: Held-out-composition split: no reduced formula appears in both train and test (stable group hash assignment).

crystal_system_ood.description: Held-out-crystal-system split: whole crystal systems assigned to one split by stable group hash.

paper_ood.description: OBELiX-style leakage-free split: entries grouped by (paper of origin, composition); any two entries sharing either must land in the same split. Bulk DFT rows (no paper) fall back to composition-only grouping.
